notes.title: Wild Romance: Mofu Mofu Edition - Update 1.3!

In what may be the quickest update yet Wild Romance: Mofu Mofu Edition 1.3 hits Steam today, I've added the following changes in this update:

- This update adds full Spanish language support to the game! We haven't added any additional voice files but everything else should be completely Spanish.
- Added a few more Spelling and Grammar fixes that were reported by members of the Cherry Kiss Community.

Thank you to those providing feedback and suggesting additional features and pointed out fixes, Wild Romance has come this far with your help I hope you all continue to enjoy Wild Romance: Mofu Mofu Edition. As usual feel free to reach out to us on our Twitter or consider joining the Cherry Kiss discord server!

notes.title: Wild Romance: Mofu Mofu Edition - Update 1.2!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31133292/d5a3a4bb8623e3b02e35436b42b2912d2e6f9421.jpg

It's been a while but we at Cherry Kiss are still working on improving Wild Romance! This time around in update 1.2 we are happy to announce the following new features and changes to the game:

- Steam trading cards are finally active, after months of waiting we hit the magic number that activated the card dropping functionality, hopefully you all enjoy collecting the cards and crafting badges!
- We have overhauled the in-game sprites with higher resolution versions so that we can make them zoom in and out when the game wants to focus on the characters face or... other parts of the body.
- As we were working on enhancing the sprites we also changed the sprite animations, no more are the days of bouncing sprites! Today we have blinking and talking animations instead.
- I've also gone through while implementing the blinky-talky sprites and revamped the game so that multiple characters appear on screen when they are "talking to each other" instead of swapping between the appropriate sprite depending on who is talking.
- I read a review that suggested we add a textbox behind the dialogue that can have a customizable opacity and so I added that too! 

As always we appreciate your feedback and hope that everyone is enjoying Wild Romance: Mofu Mofu Edition, feel free to reach out to us on our Twitter or consider joining the Cherry Kiss discord server!

notes.title: Wild Romance: Mofu Mofu Edition - Version 1.1!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31133292/4c6f055cd96f3fe37da8fc4d73ec028a4be88efe.jpg

We've been listening to your feedback in the Steam Forum and on Twitter and we're excited to reveal Wild Romance: Mofu Mofu Edition version 1.1.  New features include:

- Steam achievements. Be sure to choose each option for your date partner to unlock them all.
- A Gallery feature accessible from the main menu. Images will unlock as you reach them in the story.
- An option for 4:3 graphics so you will be able to see some of the original versions of backgrounds we edited when creating the 16:9 version

Trading Cards are loaded up in the back-end. We are awaiting the mystic condition that unlocks them for you but rest assured they are there! 

I hope you're all enjoying the Mofu Mofu Edition. If you have other requests or comments please let us know. Also, we're starting to plan our next move as you may have heard on Twitter and welcome your suggestions on the next Norn/Miel title to bring to Steam. We appreciate your feedback!
